verdict.rationale: Buzz documents named channels/rooms and threads exist: agents "post the threads" and the benchmark grades "reply-to-thread" behavior. Nothing shows that every conversation is required to sit under a named topic or thread, or that there is any catch-up tooling for busy channels. missing for 10: evidence of mandatory named topics or threads for all messages, thread naming, an unread or catch-up view for busy channels, and hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a team-admin, I can catch up on busy channels efficiently because every conversation is organized under a named topic or thread

citations.quote: Agents search six months of history and post the threads, not vibes.
